summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan for the Neydhal Heritage Storefront: adding a dynamic 5-tier Homepage with carousels (banners, featured categories, Salem artisan shorts/reels, new arrivals, bestsellers), multi-select dropdown filter menus on the catalog (Stock, Price Range, Colour, Size), boxed and color-coded order stage filter tabs with a compact search input, removing the Profile Privacy card from the customer account, and scoping the order cancellation policy notice strictly to checkout.
